verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a REST API with reference pages, a published OpenAPI spec and the firectl CLI. None of it documents an official Fireworks client SDK (for example a Python or JS library). OpenAI compatibility lets users reuse a third-party SDK, and an OpenAPI spec or REST API is only a building block for generating clients, so neither counts as an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
